headline: Authors report that gradient-guided fine-tuning data filtering reduces jailbreak success across three model families
summary: A new preprint presents SimpleLoRIF, a gradient-embedding method for locating benign-looking fine-tuning examples associated with unsafe behavior. The authors report that removing the 20% of Tulu 3 examples most aligned with unsafe responses reduced GCG attack success across Qwen, Llama and Olmo, while largely preserving selected capability scores. These are bounded author-reported results; the paper tests one target set and general safety, and independent reproduction remains open.
